# Privacy and Lifecycle Checklist: site navigation map for browser agents

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the privacy, security and map-lifecycle requirements (capture boundaries, isolation, owner control, freshness, ranking and limits) before formal planning.
**Created**: 2026-10-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the retention of existing map entries specified when the map or website memory is disabled (kept, hidden, or deleted)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §AC-11]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified whether deleting a site's website memory (003) also deletes that site's map entries? [Gap, Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Is a total bound across all origins of a profile defined, in addition to the per-origin page limit and the per-page control limit? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the contents of an owner export defined (page and control fields, read contexts, use counts, last-use results, counters)? [Completeness, Spec §AC-16]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the "expected destination" defined for controls that open a menu or dialog without a page change? [Gap, Spec §AC-09, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK006 Are recovery requirements defined for damaged or unreadable map storage: what is kept, and what agents and the owner are told? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §AC-23]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the map's part of the reminder specified for batch results, as 003 specifies its reminder for batch steps? [Gap, Spec §AC-26, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the content of one outline line defined (which fields, in what order) within the 1,000-character bound? [Completeness, Spec §AC-33, §SC-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "content area" defined distinctly from "main area", so that a main-area button inside a record list is classified one way only? [Ambiguity, Spec §AC-06, §AC-14, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "cut short" defined for a complete read, and does the spec address that long pages may rarely give a complete read, so not-seen marks may seldom occur? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the read context of a destination learned from a click defined: the context of the page the control was on, or of the page reached? [Ambiguity, Spec §AC-20, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Is a "use" of a remembered control defined precisely enough to attribute it (same page, role and name), including a use made without a prior lookup? [Clarity, Spec §AC-31]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the matching rule for the data-changing vocabulary specified (whole word, phrase or substring; Arabic word forms such as prefixed and inflected verbs)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, §AC-32]
- [ ] CHK014 Is path-prefix matching defined at segment boundaries (so `/health` does not exclude `/healthy`), and is it defined whether the prefix applies before or after masking? [Clarity, Spec §AC-34]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the naming of an origin in a lookup clarified (scheme, `www` and bare hosts, ports), given that the user may say "example.com" for `www.example.com`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §AC-05]
- [ ] CHK016 Is Arabic normalization in matching specified beyond diacritics (alef forms أ/إ/آ/ا, taa marbuta ة/ه, alef maqsura ى/ي)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §AC-02]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "long random-looking identifier or token" defined with measurable criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §AC-15]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the way the owner identifies one page entry (for single-entry deletion and inspection) defined in terms the owner sees? [Clarity, Spec §AC-16]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK019 Is eviction by least recently seen (FR-011) consistent with ranking by working status and use count (FR-007), or is evicting a heavily used page that was not seen recently stated as intended? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the map's 600-character addition specified as part of one combined reminder bound with 003, or as a separate bound? [Consistency, Spec §SC-006, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK021 Is "the map never acts" consistent with one-step use, where locating and acting form a single step that the agent chooses? [Consistency, Spec §AC-09, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK022 Do AC-19 and AC-31 agree on whether a direct open that lands on a sign-in page lowers the page's rank, although the page may still be valid after sign-in? [Conflict, Spec §AC-19, §AC-31, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the confirmation-prompt requirements for agent requests to delete a page entry or exclude a path as specific as those for enabling the map? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §AC-17]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK024 Is SC-002's "at least 50%" tied to a defined baseline route and number of runs? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the savings estimate method required to be fixed before planning ends, so that the correctness of the counters can be measured? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK026 Are latency limits defined for a lookup without a tab and for the outline, in addition to a lookup on an origin at its limits? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for a remembered address that answers with an error other than not found (server error, blocked page, timeout)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §AC-29]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for sites whose structure at one address differs by the language or region the user chose? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the lookup result defined for an origin that has no map entries but has 003 shared facts? [Coverage, Alternate Flow, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the outcome defined when a ready locator matches a control in a different page area than the remembered one? [Coverage, Spec §AC-09, §FR-010]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK031 Are masking false positives (for example a year such as 2026 or a model number in a navigation label) addressed, including their effect on addressability and on lookup words? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK032 Is a profile used with several accounts on one site addressed beyond "they share one map", for example use counts and last-use results that mix accounts? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §Assumptions]

## Non-Functional Requirements (Security and Privacy)

- [ ] CHK033 Is a threat model stated for lookups by named origin, including a hostile page that instructs the agent to look up another site's map and reveal it? [Security, Gap, Spec §FR-007, §AC-21]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for map content in diagnostics and logs when a map failure is reported? [Security, Spec §AC-23, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK035 Is a retention option, or the rationale for no time-based expiry, stated for the map, given that it holds page addresses (a form of browsing history)? [Privacy, Assumption, Spec §FR-010, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK036 Are use counts and last-use results classified as behavior data, with the same profile isolation, export and deletion rules as the entries? [Privacy, Spec §FR-001, §FR-005]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 Is the dependency on 003's anonymity verdict documented, including how an allowlist change that flips a site's verdict affects existing read contexts? [Dependency, Spec §FR-001, §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK038 Are the owner decisions pending at spec review (profile as the account boundary, stored personal names, sensitive public paths) recorded with an approval point before planning? [Assumption, Spec §FR-005, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK039 Are the proposed constitution's `CRITICAL` artifacts (a machine-readable contract and an evidence manifest) acknowledged as proposed and not yet required? [Dependency, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK040 Is profile verification for a lookup without a tab on the origin traced to an existing 003 mechanism? [Dependency, Spec §AC-05, §FR-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Generated before `plan.md` exists: the prerequisites script requires a plan, so feature paths were taken with `--paths-only`; items check `spec.md` only
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
